tagline.en_US: Organize service links, widgets and integrations in a home dashboard.

description.en_US: Homarr is a customizable dashboard designed to organize and access self-hosted applications and services in one place. It features a drag-and-drop grid system and integrates directly with numerous third-party tools to display real-time widget data and status updates. The platform also includes user management with role-based permissions and a built-in search tool to find items across connected services.
